## Review checklist

- [ ] The branch is focused and leaves its owned scope usable.
- [ ] Applicable formatting, tests, documentation, and link checks pass.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, sensitive data, model artifacts, unpublished planning, or personal paths.
- [ ] Claims distinguish documented, mock, synthetic, estimated, and real evidence.
- [ ] Documentation, compatibility notes, and changelog are updated where required.
- [ ] Deferred work and blockers are explicit.
